title: DLSS 5 community developments for SkyrimVR / MGO

rows.change: Batches VR Feature 18 evaluation with a D3D12 command-context ring and GPU fence dependencies; CPU waits only under backpressure.
rows.performanceSignal: Strongest SkyrimVR-specific performance candidate; no FPS delta published.

rows.change: Runs Feature 18 on tonemapped LDR before UI; VR uses two foveated eye regions and requires PerfMode plus Foveated Default; frame generation is disabled.
rows.performanceSignal: Correctness and coverage prerequisite for a VR path.

rows.change: Captures the final SBS composite submitted to the HMD for screenshots, improving eye-correct A/B evidence.
rows.performanceSignal: Measurement / QA improvement, not a rendering optimization.

rows.change: Adds a working 50–100% work-resolution slider for 64-bit and 32-bit paths, plus fence/TDR and format fixes. Release notes verify several non-Skyrim test values, but give no FPS deltas.
rows.performanceSignal: Potential GPU reduction after native stability; still a 1:1 DLAA contract, not true DLSS SR.

rows.change: Adds end-to-end OpenGL support for both bitnesses; otherwise unchanged from 0.6.1. The published 0.13 ms/frame CPU figure is from Worms OpenGL at 4K.
rows.performanceSignal: Useful transport precedent, not a SkyrimVR result.

rows.change: Feeder documentation says 64-bit D3D9/D3D11/D3D12 users can use the in-process RenoDX add-on directly, with same-adapter D3D12 interop and shared depth / motion-vector resources. v4.6 support is explicitly unverified; released Feeder builds remain pinned to v4.55.
rows.performanceSignal: May remove a separate bridge / IPC failure surface; no VR measurement published.

rows.change: Serializes concurrent NGX evaluations after a race fix; the author reports 5,400 fault-free Vulkan frames after the fix. The tested path is Vulkan, not SkyrimVR's D3D11 renderer.
rows.performanceSignal: Stability pattern worth borrowing, not an FPS improvement.

rows.change: Maintains VR stereo optimizations, foveated rendering compatible with DLSS/FSR, shader-cache and performance fixes. This is the underlying VR framework, not DLSS 5 itself.
rows.performanceSignal: Dependency / baseline improvement; not a DLSS5 benchmark.

source.label: Web review of primary community repositories and release notes, checked 2026-08-31
source.sql: SELECT reviewed community release and commit rows for the DLSS5 / SkyrimVR applicability review
filters: Primary author repositories / project pages only
No social posts or third-party benchmark claims used as acceptance evidence

metricDefinitions.label: MGO relevance
metricDefinitions.definition: Qualitative applicability to SkyrimVR x64/D3D11, SBS stereo, and the protected MGO prototype boundary; it is not a compatibility guarantee.

metricDefinitions.label: Performance signal
metricDefinitions.definition: The performance or scheduling implication explicitly documented by the project author. Missing FPS deltas are intentional and should not be filled by inference.

rows.whatItChanges: Moves per-frame dependency handling to GPU fences and only applies CPU backpressure when the command ring is saturated.
rows.MGOValue: First candidate to benchmark in the SkyrimVR branch.

rows.whatItChanges: Builds an owned lower-resolution SRV frame, samples depth / motion vectors / masks, then expands to native output.
rows.MGOValue: Potential GPU saving once native Feature 18 is stable; start at 100% and step down.

rows.whatItChanges: Uses same-adapter device-only D3D12 interop and shares bit-exact RG32F motion vectors plus R32_FLOAT depth.
rows.MGOValue: Could remove the separate bridge / IPC failure surface; requires isolated A/B.
rows.confidence: Medium architecture evidence; unverified in VR

rows.whatItChanges: Uses NVIDIA driver motion vectors instead of a third-party shader in the Vulkan bridge.
rows.MGOValue: Not a first move for SkyrimVR D3D11; retain as a future Vulkan / synthetic-contract option.
rows.confidence: High author measurement; wrong API / flat test

rows.publishedResult: 0.13 ms/frame CPU in Worms OpenGL at 4K
rows.whatItChanges: Measures host-side Feeder CPU overhead in a flat OpenGL game after v0.7.0.
rows.MGOValue: Useful ceiling for transport discussion only; cannot predict VR frame time.

source.label: Published performance signals from community author notes; no SkyrimVR FPS benchmark found
source.sql: SELECT documented performance mechanisms and measurements, retaining API and test-scope caveats
filters: Performance claims kept with original API, game, resolution, and measurement scope

metricDefinitions.label: Published result
metricDefinitions.definition: A number or explicit verification statement published by the upstream community project; blank or qualitative values are preserved as such.

rows.localEvidence: Native DLAA Feature 18 created and evaluated for 60 frames at 2496×2688→2496×2688 in the isolated prototype.
rows.whatRemains: This is native-size DLAA evidence, not proof of a reduced-resolution or VR neural output path.

rows.localEvidence: Quality/upscale attempt returned 0xBAD00005 and latched to native fallback; the later fork run had no confirmed nvngx_dlssnr.dll evaluation.
rows.whatRemains: Repair the resource / contract boundary before measuring performance.

rows.localEvidence: The live fork process reached loader / save-load and loaded relevant modules, but no eye-correct neural output or SBS acceptance was proven.
rows.whatRemains: Verify both eyes, head motion, final SBS composite, and compositor stability.

rows.localEvidence: No accepted DLSS5 neural frame delivery exists against which GPU frame time, CPU frame time, VRAM, or compositor behavior can be compared.
rows.whatRemains: Only compare matched vanilla, conventional DLSS/DLAA, and experimental runs after output acceptance.

rows.localEvidence: Prototype work is isolated from the known-good MGO installation and active profile.
rows.whatRemains: Keep the current MGO profile unchanged during community-version retests.
